questions.question: A hazard becomes a disaster when:
options: It overwhelms a community's capacity to cope
questions.rationale: A disaster is a hazard plus vulnerability: losses are widespread only when the event exceeds what people can handle themselves.

questions.question: Which is the most severe seismic zone into which India is divided?
questions.rationale: The Bureau of Indian Standards uses zones II to V, with Zone V the most severe, covering the north-east, Kutch, Himalaya, and Andaman and Nicobar.

questions.question: The devastating Bhuj earthquake occurred on which date?
questions.rationale: The Bhuj (Kutch) quake struck on Republic Day, 26 January 2001, measuring about 7.7 and killing roughly 20,000 people.

questions.question: Why does India's east coast suffer more cyclones than the west coast?
options: The Bay of Bengal breeds far more storms than the Arabian Sea
The Western Ghats block all storms
The east coast has no ports
questions.rationale: Warm Bay of Bengal waters generate many more cyclones than the Arabian Sea, striking Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, and West Bengal.

questions.question: In a coastal cyclone, what kills most people?
options: The storm surge of seawater pushed ashore
questions.rationale: The storm surge floods low coasts and drowns far more people than wind, which is why coastal evacuation saves the most lives.

questions.question: After the 2004 tsunami, India set up its tsunami early warning centre in which year and city?
questions.rationale: The Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre began in 2007 at Hyderabad, run by INCOIS, to issue alerts for the Indian Ocean.

questions.question: The NDMA, created under the Disaster Management Act of 2005, is chaired by:
options: The Chief of the Army Staff
questions.rationale: The National Disaster Management Authority is chaired by the Prime Minister, with state and district authorities below it.

questions.question: Which phases of the disaster management cycle come before the event?
questions.rationale: Mitigation and preparedness act in advance — zoning, codes, drills, warnings — while response and recovery follow the impact.

questions.question: The Sendai Framework for disaster risk reduction covers which period?
questions.rationale: The Sendai Framework runs from 2015 to 2030 and guides national strategies, including India's, for cutting disaster risk.

questions.question: The recommended indoor action during earthquake shaking is:
questions.rationale: Drop-Cover-Hold on under strong furniture protects head and body; running or standing in doorways causes most injuries.
